Start here · the uncomfortable bit

You think you’re fine. Here’s what is actually happening.

None of these show up as a problem on any given day. That is exactly why they cost the most.

The calls you never hear about

They rang three tradies and booked whoever answered first. You never got a missed-call notification, so you never knew the job existed.

The quotes sitting in your phone

Two people asked for a price this week. You meant to do it tonight. They signed someone else by Wednesday and you never found out why.

The old customers who forgot you

They were happy. They would use you again. Nobody ever reminded them — and a reminder costs you nothing once the system does it.

Add one job a month back and it has paid for itself. Most tradies are missing more than that.

Objections · answered before you ask them

Three things every tradie says

“It’s all word of mouth”

Great — now protect it. Word of mouth still calls, texts and messages your Facebook. When you are under a house, those go unanswered, and that referral lands on the next bloke.

“I’m too busy already”

Then you are leaving money on the table. Busy means you are choosing between jobs by accident. This shows you what the week is worth and which jobs pay best, so busy turns into profitable.

“I’m not a computer person”

Nothing to learn. You read a draft, press Send, and drag a card. If you can use text messages you can run this — and we sit with you the first week.

Run a trade?
Sound familiar?

None of this is a skills problem. It is a systems problem — every message lives somewhere different, so jobs slip through.

Missed calls, lost jobs

You are on the tools all day. Every call that rings out goes straight to the next bloke on Google.

Quoting at 9pm

Hours every week re-typing the same prices into quotes, texts and emails — with no consistency.

Messages scattered

Facebook, Instagram, SMS, email, website forms. Six inboxes, no single view, follow-ups forgotten.

What you are looking at · no jargon

This is one screen instead of six apps

The industry word is “CRM”. It means one place where every customer conversation and every job lives. That is the whole idea.

What it is

Every enquiry, quote, booked job and follow-up on one screen — telling you what needs you next.

What it replaces

The notebook, the diary, six messaging apps, the whiteboard, the “I’ll quote it tonight” pile.

What it is not

Not something that replaces you. It sits underneath you and does the paperwork and the remembering.

If you can use text messages, you can use this.

What it feels like on a normal Tuesday

A day, start to finish

7:10am

Coffee, one glance

Four new enquiries, two quotes waiting on your OK, today’s bookings. Thirty seconds.

9:40am

You are under a sink

Three calls come in. All three answered, details taken, two visits booked, one price-shopper flagged.

12:05pm

Smoko

Two drafts are waiting. Read, tweak a word, send. The quote is already priced from your rates.

7:00pm

Not quoting

The follow-ups you would normally do at night already went out. Tomorrow is set up.

Module 01 · Inbox

Every channel in one list

Calls, emails, website enquiries, Instagram, Messenger and SMS land in one place. The AI has written the reply — you check it and press Send. Your job: read, send.

Module 02 · Pipeline

Know where every job stands

New enquiry, quoted, won. Every card carries its price and its history, with the week’s total at the top. Your job: drag the card when the job moves.

Module 03 · AI Receptionist

Never miss another call

It answers 24/7, takes the job details, tells you what the call was about and books the visit in. Time-wasters are flagged and never get your mobile. Your job: nothing.

Module 04 · Estimator

Prices every job from your rates

Open a job and the price is worked out from your own rates, cross-checked against your past jobs, with the working shown. Your job: check the number, confirm it.

Module 05 · Rulebook

Your business, taught once

Your greeting, your rules, your starting prices. Every AI reply follows them — it never quotes below your floor and never promises what you cannot do. Your job: tell us once.

Module 06 · The board

Your day at a glance

What needs your attention, what the pipeline is worth, where the work came from, what is booked. Your job: look at it once with your coffee.

In the ute, on site, anywhere

Same dashboard, full size, on the phone in your pocket. No app store, no downloads — it opens in your browser.

Your side of the deal

What you actually have to do

Almost nothing — and we are honest about the small bits that need you.

Once, at the start

✓One 45 minute setup call — the most valuable half hour of the whole job.
✓Send us your price list, or just tell us your rates out loud.
✓Tell us your rules: service area, jobs you refuse, minimum callout.
✓Give us access to your number and your page accounts. We do the rest.

Ongoing

✓Press Send on the replies you are happy with.
✓Drag job cards along when work moves — or tell us and we will.
✓Ring or email us when something reads wrong. Changes are included.
✓Nothing else. No admin days, no data entry, no software to learn.

After you are live

Trust · the limits, in writing

What the AI will never do

It will never…

✓Send a message to a customer without you pressing Send.
✓Quote below the floor price you set.
✓Invent a price, a timeframe or a promise you have not approved.
✓Give your mobile number to a cold caller or a price-shopper.

And you keep…

✓Your number, your name, your reputation — all in your name.
✓Your customer list and job history — exportable any time.
✓The final say on every price and every message.
✓A local phone number to ring when you want a human.

The questions everyone asks

Straight answers

Do I have to be good with computers?

No. Read a text, press Send, drag a card.

What if the AI says something wrong?

It cannot send anything without you — every reply waits as a draft.

Can I keep my current number?

Yes. Calls you cannot take get answered; everything else works as normal.

What about my old quotes and jobs?

We bring them across — it prices new jobs against your history.

What if I stop working with you?

Your data is yours, exportable, no lock-in contract.

How long until it is running?

Live within a fortnight of the setup call.
